corrections.reason: The printed glyph at the start of line 31 is 6th-order labiovelar ጕ (forming ተርጕሞለታል across the line wrap, matching line 16), not ጐ.
Both the printed glyph (showing the 6th-order 'ል' ring on the left leg) and Classical Ge'ez morphology ('ጽድቀ ሕልሚሁ' - the truth of his dreams, Gen 37:20) confirm ሕልሚሁ rather than ሕለሚሁ.
